libs.note: BH-1939 (BH-1511.2). The GitHub rate-limit budget library, sourced by 17 lanes. Applied by gh-budget.sh itself at file scope, in a subshell, so a fail-closed exit never stops the lane that sourced it. GH_BUDGET_DB (the 0/1 switch for the shared half) and GH_BUDGET_MIN_REMAINING (already a settings row through setting_get gh_budget_min_remaining) are not registered here.

knobs.note: How long one rate_limit reading (the box cache, and the fleet row it pulls) is trusted before a fresh read. Was ${GH_BUDGET_TTL_S:-60}.
The jobs-worker timeout for the shared budget row's GET and PUT, so a worker outage delays a lane by seconds. Was ${GH_BUDGET_DB_TIMEOUT_S:-4}.
